local function _fcaObd0I1fao(t,k)
local r=""
for i=1,#t do
local v=t[i]
v=(v-109)%256 if v<0 then v=v+256 end v=(v-18)%256 if v<0 then v=v+256 end v=(v-29)%256 if v<0 then v=v+256 end v=(v-96)%256 if v<0 then v=v+256 end
r=r..string.char(v)
end
return r
end
local function _01Oollalood0()

end
